messages.subject: include problem; test-headers for templates?
parts:
I'm working on branch feature/softmax-unfold and I'm
blocked on an error I don't understand that arises
when I include error checking headers.

I've pushed where I'm at on the branch, so you can
follow along by checking it out.

But I want to add one more function that needs check_bounded.

On a fresh checkout, everything's fine:


|
|
~/stan(feature/softmax-unfold)$ mk test/math/matrix/log_softmax
...
test/math/matrix/log_softmax --gtest_output="xml:test/math/matrix/log_softmax.xml"

Now the get() is defined in stan/meta/traits.hpp, which is not being brought in
by check_bounded.

I'm confused about this because test-headers works just fine. Is it not
doing enough testing anything because nothing is instantiating the template
function? It doesn't really know enough to test the includes because a function
could always be found by argument-dependent lookup.
